common.serviceName: Send money to someone in prison

paymentChoice.intro: Paying by debit card is fast, simple, reliable and free and the best way of sending money to a prisoner.
paymentChoice.body1: You can complete your payment here using Mastercard, Visa and Maestro debit cards.
paymentChoice.body2: Money usually takes less than 3 working days to reach a prisoner’s account, but may take longer.
paymentChoice.body3: You’ll get email confirmation of payment.
paymentChoice.body4: You can make an international payment using a debit card.
